software.name: SAS 9.4 TS1M8
software.description: The documented author language is SAS. The program requires SAS data steps, SQL, sort/means/export, PROC REG, and PROC LOGISTIC. The machine has a SAS 9.4 TS1M8 executable, but an independent runtime probe failed during TKELS initialization; this does not establish procedure entitlement or a missing license.

issues.description: The supplied SAS entry point actively includes winsor.sas, ccm.sas, io_ts.sas, iccmlink.sas, and evtstudy08.sas, but none is listed in the extracted package inventory. Their macro bodies, produced dataset schemas, timing/history rules, and output naming conventions cannot be verified from the entry file alone. The Table 9C evtstudy call uses outset=carjapp_madj while its consumer reads carjapp_madj0; preserve this as a macro-contract unknown rather than guessing a suffix change.

The code comment says io_ts.sas generates fci.io_timeseries, but that producer is absent; its fields, holdings source, date history, and compatibility with the downstream PERMNO/date join are unresolved.

The full supplied workflow depends on 31 distinct raw, curated, or vendor inputs. Twelve local commercial product candidates have matching bounded field probes, four verified public product routes remain to be acquired/prepared, and the remaining distinct source/curated inputs retain specific unresolved route or construction questions. Final_sample.csv exposes only a gvkey column, so it does not support a separate analysis-only path.

The SAS entry point hard-codes [redacted-path-2e0b279e56d6], [redacted-path-d9f18d2760ed], [redacted-path-75f4a0e34c3a] and a tilde project/output directory. Frozen local product candidates live under ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}; path, permission, required library mappings, relative input directory, and output writeability have not been validated.

A bounded environment probe found the installed SAS 9.4 TS1M8 executable but it failed TKELS initialization. The failure does not establish a missing license or entitlement; runtime availability for the author workflow remains unverified.
